thought.text: Let me check the DB credentials and verify onboarding data.

reasoning_content: Interesting - the backup run recreated postgres container. Let me get the DB credentials from .env and check tables. Also let me verify the school/teacher were created via the API.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -E "^DB_(USER|NAME|PASS)|^POSTGRES" .env | sed 's/PASS=.*/PASS=***/' && echo "---" && docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "\dt"' 2>&1 | head -40
